claims.claim_text: The indexed Technical Sergeant Justin Bergman Jr. is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.

claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private identifier and compatible name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated July 20, 1942; the later OSS sequence is not established.

research_attempts.query_text: Justin Bergman Jr.: NARA index and official Army merged-file identifier/name checks; CIA Reading Room; exact-name OSS variants; employment and occupation; institutional, newspaper, obituary, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A discovery-only life-summary result offered dates but no inspectable employer evidence or independent OSS linkage and was not used as a claim source.
research_attempts.research_notes: Official records confirm identity and an Army-entry occupation category. No reliable named employer or immediate pre-OSS affiliation was found in accessible sources.
